description_en: Updates the settings of the Lightweight Directory Access Protocol (LDAP) authentication server of a bastion host
description_zh: 修改堡垒机实例LDAP认证服务器的配置
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost modify-instance-ldap-auth-server --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --server 192.168.XX.XX --port 389 --base-dn dc=test,dc=com --account cn=Manager,dc=test,dc=com --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyInstanceLDAPAuthServer

parameters.help_en:
The bastion host ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query the bastion host ID
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host.

For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的地域ID。
Region ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The address of the LDAP server
parameters.name: server

parameters.help_en: The address of the secondary LDAP server
parameters.name: standby_server

parameters.help_en: The port that is used to access the LDAP server
parameters.name: port

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to support SSL. Valid values:

true

false
parameters.help_zh:
是否支持SSL。取值：

true：支持
false：不支持
parameters.name: is_ssl

parameters.help_en: The username of the account that is used for the LDAP server
parameters.name: account

parameters.help_en: The password of the account that is used for the LDAP server. You must configure a password when you configure LDAP authentication. If you leave this parameter empty when you modify the settings of LDAP authentication, the current password is used
parameters.help_zh: 服务器账号的密码。添加LDAP认证服务器时为必填。修改LDAP认证服务器信息时，不填则表示保留当前密码
parameters.name: password

parameters.help_en: The condition that is used to filter users
parameters.name: filter

parameters.help_en: The field that is used to indicate the logon name of a user on the LDAP server
parameters.help_zh: 用户登录名对应服务器的属性名
parameters.name: login_name_mapping

parameters.help_en: The field that is used to indicate the name of a user on the LDAP server
parameters.help_zh: 用户名称对应服务器的属性名
parameters.name: name_mapping

parameters.help_en: The field that is used to indicate the email address of a user on the LDAP server
parameters.help_zh: 用户邮箱对应服务器的属性名
parameters.name: email_mapping

parameters.help_en: The field that is used to indicate the mobile phone number of a user on the LDAP server
parameters.help_zh: 用户手机号对应服务器的属性名
parameters.name: mobile_mapping

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request, which is used to locate and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
